description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the Acquisition of the land in Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition and compensation deposits under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed information about specific land parcels (lot numbers, map numbers, land names, extents), compensation amounts, and court case details for deposited funds. The content is exclusively focused on land matters, specifically the acquisition process and compensation for state-acquired land where no claimants appeared, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
